title: 外链检测：数据 key
description: 三个都是选填，只保存在本机（~/.workbuddy 目录下），连接时交给本机的服务器，不经过云端。verify、submissions 和 vet 的免费模式不需要 key；其余工具要 Glasser 或 AIsa 的 key，两个都填时先用 Glasser。下面的注册链接是作者的推荐链接，从各家官网直接拿的 key 用起来完全一样。
description_en: All three are optional. They stay on this machine (under ~/.workbuddy) and go to the local server when it starts, never through a cloud. verify, submissions and vet's free mode need no key; the other tools need a Glasser or an AIsa key, and Glasser is used first when both are set. The sign-up links below are the author's referral links; a key from each site directly works the same.
docLabel: 每个 key 管什么、各工具花多少钱
docLabel_en: What each key is for, and what each tool costs

fields.label: Glasser API key（推荐）
fields.description: 垃圾分、Google 搜索历史、新增和丢失的引荐域、锚文本、逐条外链、竞品的引荐域、Google AI 概览。注册（作者的推荐链接）：https://link.glasser.ai/JasonZhu
fields.description_en: Spam scores, Google search history, new and lost referring domains, anchors, backlinks one by one, competitors' referring domains, Google's AI Overviews. Sign up (the author's referral link): https://link.glasser.ai/JasonZhu

fields.label: AIsa API key
fields.description: 没有 Glasser key 时查同样的数据；AI 助手的回答（questions、asked）、vet 深查里的 Ahrefs 和 Semrush 数据、site: 搜索只有 AIsa 有。注册（作者的推荐链接）：https://go.aisa.one/yansen-zhu
fields.description_en: The same data when there is no Glasser key; and what only AIsa sells here: the AI assistants' answers (questions, asked), the Ahrefs and Semrush numbers of vet's deep mode, and site: searches. Sign up (the author's referral link): https://go.aisa.one/yansen-zhu

fields.label: GoAnyAPI key（可选）
fields.description: 站点评分、访问量、收录情况和你自己的外链摘要。注册（作者的推荐链接）：https://goanyapi.com/r/ga-95708898fb
fields.description_en: Site ratings, visits, index status and your own backlink summary. Sign up (the author's referral link): https://goanyapi.com/r/ga-95708898fb
